entities.summary: Friedrich-Wilhelm Bock was a German Waffen-SS commander during World War II who led three SS divisions, the SS Division Hohenstaufen, 4th SS Polizei Division, Waffen Grenadier Division of the SS. He was awarded the Knight's Cross of the Iron Cross of Nazi Germany.
